run.ended.meaning: Says on the Timeline, on the day it happens, that a Behavior reached its end, with Start again and Close.

run.paused.meaning: Says on the Timeline, on the first paused day, that a Behavior is paused and when it comes back, with Resume now and Close.
run.paused.text: {back, select, none {{title} is paused.} other {{title} is paused, back {back}.}}

run.back-today.meaning: Says on the Timeline, on its back-on day, that a paused Behavior runs again, with Close.

run.end-time-passed.meaning: Refuses an end or a pause start set to a moment that has passed, in the Behavior form, Chat and MCP.
run.end-time-passed.text: Pick a time later than now. To stop it right away, use End now.

run.pause-back-on.meaning: Refuses a pause whose back-on day is not after its first paused day and after today.
run.pause-back-on.text: Pick a back-on day after the first paused day and after today.
